name: Flight Club
subtitle: Under the Influence Ministries
tagline: A Christian mastermind for missional entrepreneurs

verse.short: If I rise on the wings of the dawn…
verse.full: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea, even there your hand will guide me.

rules: Confidential means confidential. Names, numbers and stories stay in the room.
Attend every session. Miss two in a row and an admin will call you.
Check in by the start of the meeting. Hot seat prep is due 24 hours before.
Start at 7:00 sharp and end on time.
Give experience, not opinions. Say what you did, not what someone should do.
Leave with one commitment you can finish before the next session.
